block_device.description: The block device or file to operate on.

definitions.description: Directory path to read *.conf partition definition files from.

root.description: Path to the root file system used for searching config files and machine-id.

factory_reset.description: Boolean to enable factory reset mode, deleting partitions marked with FactoryReset=yes.

empty.description: How to operate on block devices with no partition table. Values: refuse, allow, require, force, create.

discard.description: Boolean to issue BLKDISCARD on free space or added partitions.

seed.description: UUID for cryptographic hashing of partition UUIDs, or 'random'.

key_file.description: Path to the encryption key file for LUKS2 volumes.

private_key.description: Path or designation for the signing key for verity signature partitions.

certificate.description: Path or designation for the X.509 certificate for verity signature partitions.

tpm2_device.description: Path to the TPM2 device for LUKS2 TPM2 enrollment.

tpm2_pcrs.description: List of PCRs for TPM2 PCR lock/seal operations.

architecture.description: Architecture override for partition types (e.g., x86-64, arm64).

offline.description: Boolean or 'auto' to enable offline image building without loop devices.

sector_size.description: Sector size in bytes for the produced image (power of 2, 512-4096).
